# Asteroid Dodge

A simple canvas game where the player controls a ship moving left/right at the bottom of the screen to avoid falling asteroids. Asteroids spawn from the top at increasing speed. The player can collect occasional power‑ups for a shield or slower falls.

**Lose condition:** The game ends immediately when the ship collides with an asteroid.
